description: UGC VZ is a free directory of real, verified UGC creators in the German-speaking region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland aka DACH Region) with portfolio and social-media proof - no AI-avatar content. Brands search the directory by free-text query, city, topics, or verification level, inspect individual creator profiles, and deliberately request contact. UGC VZ then delivers the creators' contact details to the brand by e-mail; the directory takes no commission. Typical workflow: search creators, review a profile, trigger an outreach request, and poll its delivery status. Creator search and profile data never expose private contact details inside ChatGPT.
